title: Code reviews per week (square)
description: Square version: code reviews per week since February 2024, the review bot and humans stacked; humans peaked at 56 a week, the bot at 161. On the grid-and-glow ground, the logo centred. Drawn from _code-reviews/data.js.
series: Code reviews: humans and the bot
source: code_reviews_weekly.csv (weekly reviews, Feb 5, 2024 to Nov 8, 2026), as of Nov 8, 2026. Square version of the landscape chart of the same name.
